REFUTED: 'The only escape is force-quitting the app.' The Companion orb IS on the screen (greyed but live) and IS in the AX tree - describe_screen returns it as AXGenericElement 'Patina companion' at {169,724,64x64}; scan_ui misses it only because scan_ui filters to interactive roles. Tapping it opens the panel, whose fourth row is 'Home, Back to your space' - one tap returned the app to the Daily Room with the session intact. Not reproducible. I opened manual room entry without touching the ft/m toggle and got the reported 59ft x 46ft / 2713 SQUARE FEET - then found the cause. The unit selection is persisted in UserDefaults under 'patina.scan.manual_entry.unit' and restored on appear (ScanFallbackEntryView.swift:70-73); plutil on the simulator container shows that key set to "m", left there by an earlier walk lane. The toggle was therefore on METRES, not 'ft', and the app was correctly reading 18m x 14m -> 59ft x 46ft = 2713 sq ft. Zooming the toggle in the walk's own geometry confirms the app renders the selected unit in near-black and the unselected one in light tan: my first pass showed 'm' dark, and after one tap on 'ft' the same pixels showed 'ft' dark. I then re-ran the identical entry with 'ft' selected: the summary read '18 ft' x '14 ft' / '252 SQUARE FEET'. There is no feet-to-metres conversion bug. The real defects in this area belong to F40 (see its adjusted note): a 6x13pt unit control, colour-only selection state, no unit suffix on the LENGTH/WIDTH fields, and a silently persisted unit choice that survives relaunch and account switch. Probes: probe/F40-manual-room-entry-unit-toggle.png + probe/_zoom-unit-toggle.png (m selected), probe/_p-after-continue.png (2713 sq ft), probe/_zoom-unit-toggle-ft.png (ft selected after one tap), probe/F18-room-summary-with-ft-selected.png (252 sq ft, correct).

Confirmed at the mechanism, and observed in the mirror direction today. AuthService.swift:169-197 keeps the device-global SwiftData store and wipes it ONLY when a DIFFERENT real account signs in; shouldWipeLocalStore returns false for a nil previous owner, and the comment says outright 'the guest's local scans are claimed by the new account'. In this session I watched the same store cross the other way: a Living Room created while signed in as client@patina.dev was still on the home as 'ACTIVE ROOM / Living Room' after a keychain reset dropped me into a fresh guest session (probe/_p-guest-home.png). Signing in as a second real account (james.okafor) then wiped it, confirming the store is device-scoped and reconciled only at the account boundary. Worth flagging to the authors that the code documents this as intended behaviour, which the finding does not mention.

CONFIRMED, and measured: describe_screen returns the 'ft' control as a Button at {346,384.33,12x13.33} and 'm' as a Button at {372,384.33,6x13.33} - 6x13pt, far under the 44pt minimum - and the resulting room does propagate to the room view, the home ACTIVE ROOM card ('Living Room. 2713 sq ft') and Profile. REFUTED: 'produces no visible state change (ft stays bold)'. Pixel-zooming the toggle shows the selected unit rendered near-black and the unselected one light tan; with the persisted unit on 'm' the 'm' glyph was dark, and one tap on 'ft' flipped the darkness to 'ft' (probe/_zoom-unit-toggle.png vs probe/_zoom-unit-toggle-ft.png). The state does change - it is just signalled by colour alone, on a 6pt target, with no unit suffix on the LENGTH/WIDTH fields. Also newly found and worth adding: the choice is written to UserDefaults 'patina.scan.manual_entry.unit' and silently restored on every later appear (ScanFallbackEntryView.swift:70-73), so one stray tap poisons every subsequent room entry across relaunches and even across account switches - plutil on the simulator container showed that key still set to 'm' days later. That persistence, not the tap itself, is what produced the 2713 sq ft room the walks blamed on a conversion bug (see F18, refuted).
corrected_observation: The 'ft / m' unit toggle on manual room entry renders 'ft' at 12x13pt and 'm' at 6x13pt - both far under the 44pt minimum - and signals which is selected by text colour alone, with no unit suffix on the LENGTH or WIDTH fields. Hitting 'm' by accident switches the entry to metres, so 18/14 becomes a 'Living Room' of 59' x 46' = 2713 sq ft, which persists to the room view, the home Active Room card and Profile. Worse, the choice is written to UserDefaults ('patina.scan.manual_entry.unit') and silently restored on every later visit, so a single stray tap keeps corrupting every room entered afterwards, across relaunches and account switches.
